svg.title: Physical topology
svg.desc: production physical design, 24 September 2026. Unresolved design decisions are explicitly labelled.
svg.text: 32 B300 servers / 256 GPUs · Frontend EVPN-VXLAN · Eight backend rails · Plane 1
2 × 400G from every leaf to EACH spine
32 fabric links · OSPF unnumbered · iBGP EVPN, spines RR
<data VLAN> · VRF k8s | <stor-mgmt VLAN> · VRF stor-mgmt
vPC Fabric Peering · no peer-link cable
vPC Fabric Peering · no peer-link cable
vPC Fabric Peering · no peer-link cable
Borders are L3-only; not a vPC pair.
Each coloured line below represents 32 dedicated 400G links to one rail leaf.
Every B300 server connects to all eight rails
256 × 400G independent links · NIC R → be-leafR · CX8 port 2 uncabled
Each grey line = 4 × 800G routed links / 128 physical links total
eBGP + BFD · 16 uplinks per leaf · BGP unnumbered · PFC + ECN (production switch config)
Per rail leaf: 12.8 Tb/s down + 12.8 Tb/s up in nominal port capacity. Same rail stays L2; cross-rail uses leaf → spine → leaf.
FE/OOB addresses, VLANs, VNIs and ASNs · FE uplink ports
Links are bundled for readability. Rates are design values. Backend PFC (priority 3) + ECN as in the production switch configuration (AI-Leaf / AI-Spine ECN_PFC_Lossless).
Source: existing production physical design and cabling matrices. This diagram intentionally does not substitute the virtual lab’s IPs or switch models.
